title: Secure Cloud Home
description:
Secure Sync Home turns your own computer into a personal cloud. Transfer and sync files, photos, and videos between all your devices over your local Wi-Fi network. No third-party servers, no monthly subscriptions — your data stays under your control, always.

🔒 PRIVACY & SECURITY
• AES-256-GCM encryption protects every file transfer
• Data travels only within your local Wi-Fi network
• No third-party servers — you are the cloud
• Trusted server verification prevents unauthorized access

📸 PHOTOS & VIDEOS
• Auto-sync: New photos and videos are backed up automatically
• Choose which albums to sync
• Browse your media in dense, normal, or large grid layouts
• Full-screen viewer with zoom, swipe navigation, and thumbnail strip
• Select multiple items to share, export, or manage

📁 FILE MANAGEMENT
• Upload, download, and organize files with a full-featured file manager
• Create folders and organize with drag and drop
• Password-protect sensitive folders with a 4-digit PIN
• Color-code folders for quick identification
• Open files directly with other apps on your device

🔍 AUTOMATIC DISCOVERY
• Devices on the same Wi-Fi are discovered automatically
• No manual IP setup — just connect and sync

🖥️ DESKTOP COMPANION
• Available for Mac, Windows, and Linux
• Sync files between your phone and computer seamlessly

⚙️ FULL CONTROL
• Choose your accent color, light/dark/system theme
• 11 languages supported with auto-detection
• Keep files on server only, or on both server and device
• Free up phone space — remove backed-up media while keeping server copies
• Sync notifications and cache management

No file size limits. No cloud fees. Your files, your network, your rules.
